content.title: From season 4: Release date, casting updates, latest news
content.text: This is not a drill! We finally have a release date for From season 4 - and it's not far away!The MGM horror sees Harold Perrineau lead an ensemble cast, and follows the residents of the nightmarish small town that fans call Fromville. While it started as a cult show, it's been growing in popularity season by season.This means that we're inching ever closer to finding out some answers after the cliffhanger of season 3's ending, including what's behind the arrival of a mysterious new villain known as The Man in Yellow, and what on earth is going on with Julie and her time travel.But when can we expect new episodes to arrive? Here's everything we know about the highly anticipated From season 4, from its release date, to some exciting casting news.From season 4 will premiere on 19th April 2026 on MGM+.The release date was announced alongside the unveiling of a first-look trailer, which teases more eerie thrills while also stating that "knowledge comes at a cost".It also ends with a chilling statement from Douglas E Hughes's character, The Man in the Yellow Suit, who says that "What happens next is my favourite part", before breaking out in an ominous smile.Want to see this content?This page contains content provided by Twitter. We ask for your permission before anything is loaded, as Twitter may use cookies and other technologies. To view this content, choose 'Accept and continue' to allow Twitter and its required purposes.As far as we know, this is the US release date. The UK release date has not yet been confirmed. Season 3 was available in the UK about four months after the series started in the US so we'd expect a similar timeline this time around - but we'll update this page with any news.In November, MGM confirmed that From season 4 has officially wrapped filming, sharing a video of the cast members celebrating on social media (which you can check out below) and the caption: "#FROM has officially wrapped and is coming soon to @mgmplus!"This 2026 release date was confirmed by Deadline, along with the news that season 4 has been filming in Nova Scotia, Canada, where the previous three seasons were filmed.Stay tuned for more news!Want to see this content?This page contains content provided by Twitter. We ask for your permission before anything is loaded, as Twitter may use cookies and other technologies. To view this content, choose 'Accept and continue' to allow Twitter and its required purposes.Which cast members will return in From season 4?Amid characters returning from season 3, a new face will also be joining the main cast of From season 4. Sophia, described as "a sheltered and vulnerable pastor’s daughter," will be played by Julia Doyle, who previously appeared in the teen comedy series Astrid & Lilly Save the World.While the rest of the cast hasn't officially been confirmed, we can expect these lead actors to return in some capacity in season 4:Harold Perrineau as Boyd StevensCatalina Sandino Moreno as Tabitha MatthewsDavid Alpay as Jade HerreraElizabeth Saunders as Donna RainesScott McCord as Victor KavanaughRicky He as Kenny LiuChloe Van Landschoot as Kristi MillerKaelen Ohm as Marielle 'Mari' SinclairPegah Ghafoori as Fatima HassanCorteon Moore as Ellis StevensHannah Cheramy as Julie MatthewsSimon Webster as Ethan MatthewsAvery Konrad as Sara MyersRobert Joy as Henry KavanaughSamantha Brown as Dani AcostaAJ Simmons as Randall KirklandNathan D Simmons as ElginDouglas E Hughes as The Man in the Yellow SuitIt wouldn't be From without the show's troubled hero Boyd Stevens, so Harold Perrineau is obviously expected to return. However there's a big question mark over another lead character, Jim (Eion Bailey), who appeared to die in the season 3 finale.This is definitely the kind of show where dead characters can return, whether it's as a ghost, a hallucination, or some kind of parallel timeline. So far there's been no official announcement about Jim's future, but he could easily return in a smaller role in season 4.There's already one obvious precedent for a dead character getting resurrected: Father Khatri, who was part of the main cast in season 1, and continued on as Boyd's hallucination buddy for the next two seasons.One character we are expecting to see more of is the Man in the Yellow Suit (Douglas E Hughes), who is clearly being set up as a recurring villain. Eagle-eyed viewers may have noticed hints of his presence earlier in the show, but the season 3 finale revealed him as a major player.What will happen in From season 4?Coinciding with the season 4 renewal announcement, From's creator John Griffin shared some hints about upcoming storylines:"In season 4, a new journey begins. The question is whether it will lead our characters home, or deeper into this unrelenting nightmare."Judging by From's previous seasons, we're going with "deeper into this unrelenting nightmare." That's really the show's defining appeal, constantly coming up with bizarre new ways to torment its main characters.Harrold Perrineau also previously spoke to RadioTimes.com about his predictions for season 4, saying he expects a "rift" and "division" between the residents of From's nameless town.The Man in the Yellow Suit (Douglas E Hughes) in From season 3. MGMAlong with a bigger role for the ominous Man in the Yellow Suit, we're expecting to see more screen time between Tabitha and Jade. Season 3 revealed that these two were married in a previous life, hinting at a potential romance now Tabitha's husband Jim is seemingly out of the picture. The show also seems to be teasing a bigger role for Julie, following the whole time-travel situation in the finale.Over on the Colony House side of the community, we can also expect some updates from the aftermath of Fatima's pregnancy, which culminated in her giving birth to a new incarnation of the Smiley Creature - one of the most memorable monsters from earlier seasons.Pegah Ghafoori as Fatima in From season 3. MGMSpeaking to The Hollywood Reporter, From's creator John Griffin said: “The mythology is our road map."But we’ve left ourselves very open to the organic nature of surprise. I won’t go into the whole metaphor, but I often think about this as a road trip where you know where you’re starting, you know where you’re ending, but you get to wander, get lost, get surprised, because you know what the structure of the trip looks like."From's chaotic storytelling style keeps fans coming back for more – but it also leaves them with a lot of unanswered questions. Actor Harold Perrineau apparently had a similar experience, admitting that even he was still baffled about one particular storyline.How many episodes will there be in From season 4?Harold Perrineau as Boyd Stevens in From season 3. MGMMuch like the first three seasons, From season 4 will consist of 10 episodes, according to Variety.Considering the show's previous track record, that will offer more than enough time for a wild array of new twists and turns.Will From season 4 be available to watch in the UK?Yes, we'd expect so. The UK release date hasn't been confirmed yet, but we'd expect it to be in 2026, soon after the US release.Given that From's previous seasons aired in the UK following the US release, we can expect season 4 to air in the UK – likely on Sky and NOW again.Is there a trailer for From season 4?Yes! Check out the teaser trailer at the top of this page.From is available on Sky Sci-Fi and NOW – sign up for Sky TV here.Check out more of our Sci-Fi coverage or visit our TV Guide and Streaming Guide to see what's on tonight.
